correctness.rationale: The rational season map F_r(x)=(1−δ)x+δrx/(1+(r−1)x) is strictly increasing for every r>0, 0<δ<1, x∈(0,1). Direct symbolic common-denominator reduction yields F_b(F_a(x))−F_a(F_b(x))=δ²(1−δ)(a−b)(a−1)(b−1)x²(1−x)²/(ABE), with A,B,E>0; its sign is independent of x, and of all other seasons. Adjacent exchanges improve final x, since any downstream map is increasing; sorting every inversion gives stated extrema and strictness modulo equal/neutral r=1. For δ=1 the odds x/(1−x) multiply by r and all maps commute. Endpoint x=0,1 and δ=1 exception boundaries explicitly excluded or stated.
